overview.text: The Speckled Racer is a fast, non-venomous snake of Mexico, Central America and the very south of Texas. Its name *margaritiferus* means 'pearl-bearing', for its pearl-like spots.

identification.text: Black, with a yellow or blue spot on each scale that gives it an overall greenish look; yellow lips with black lines, and a yellow-green belly.

size.label: Adults
size.text: About 76 to 102 cm (30 to 40 in) long.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Southern Texas, Mexico and Central America to Panama and north-western Colombia, from sea level to about 1,450 m.

behaviour.text: Fast, agile and active by day. It is nervous and bites if handled; some have been seen to play dead.

recognise.text: Black with a pale spot on every scale, looking greenish.
